signature: SUBROUTINE ZPBTRS( UPLO, N, KD, NRHS, AB, LDAB, B, LDB, INFO )

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular factor stored in `AB`;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular factor stored in `AB`.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: kd
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals of the matrix A if `UPLO = 'U'`, or the number of subdiagonals if `UPLO = 'L'`. $\mathrm{KD} \ge 0$.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrix B. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference: The triangular factor U or L from the Cholesky factorization $A = U^H \, U$ or $A = L \, L^H$ of the band matrix A, stored in the first `KD`+1 rows of the array. The j-th column of U or L is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: if `UPLO ='U'`, `AB(kd+1+i-j,j) = U(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{kd}) \le i \le j$; if `UPLO ='L'`, `AB(1+i-j,j) = L(i,j)` for $j \le i \le \min (n,j+\mathrm{kd})$.

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AB`. $\mathrm{LDAB} \ge \mathrm{KD}+1$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the right hand side matrix B. On exit, the solution matrix X.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
